gloss: assistant store manager; deputy shop manager

definitions.gloss: assistant store manager; deputy shop manager
definitions.explanation: The second-in-command at a shop or restaurant, who supports the {店長|てんちょう} and takes charge in their absence.

examples.japanese: {副店長|ふくてんちょう}に{昇格|しょうかく}した。
examples.english: I was promoted to assistant store manager.

examples.japanese: {店長|てんちょう}がいない{日|ひ}は{副店長|ふくてんちょう}が{店|みせ}を{任|まか}される。
examples.english: On days when the manager is out, the assistant manager is put in charge of the store.

examples.japanese: {新人|しんじん}の{教育|きょういく}やシフトの{調整|ちょうせい}は、{主|おも}に{副店長|ふくてんちょう}の{仕事|しごと}だ。
examples.english: Training new staff and adjusting the shift schedule are mainly the assistant manager's job.

notes:
The prefix {副|ふく} (vice-, deputy) attached to {店長|てんちょう} (store manager). The same prefix forms many job titles.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {副店長|ふくてんちょう}になる: to become assistant manager
- {副店長|ふくてんちょう}を{務|つと}める: to serve as assistant manager
- {副店長|ふくてんちょう}{代理|だいり}: acting assistant manager

OTHER TITLES WITH {副|ふく}:
- {副社長|ふくしゃちょう}: vice-president of a company
- {副部長|ふくぶちょう}: deputy department head
- {副校長|ふくこうちょう}: vice-principal
